relevance_note: Single case report of a woman with Danon disease and a LAMP2 variant: "Genetic testing identified a novel de novo LAMP2 gene mutation (c.510_515delTGTTCTinsG, p.Asp170Glufs*15)".
method_note: Read the whole paper (one case, no tables); built JSON by a short script from my own reading and checked every span verbatim by script. Label 'patient' (rule 5). Inheritance left 'not reported': the paper calls the mutation 'de novo' but states no parental testing (rule 8 / D-24); zygosity not stated. The figure legend prints the protein change as 'p.Asp1 70Glufs*15' (with a space) while the text prints 'p.Asp170Glufs*15'; the text form is recorded. 'Her muscle strength and academic performance were normal' recorded as excluded 'muscle weakness' and excluded 'poor academic performance' (D-27); the checklist item proximal muscle weakness was set excluded from normal muscle strength, but the composite intellectual disability/cognitive impairment/learning difficulties item left 'not reported' because normal academic performance does not explicitly address all of it. Heart failure not stated as such (only elevated NT-proBNP, LVEF 33%), so left 'not reported'. Vital status and treatment not reported. The figure legend describes LGE as 'subendocardial and transmural' while the text says 'subendocardial'; not a contradiction about presence.
